definition: Our unique key for one row of the SNL page: network name | ADM | 7-year limit date. Needed because name + ADM alone repeats (L5, HIBLEO-2FL2 and USASAT-NGSO-9C each appear twice).

sheets: Overview, networks, milestones, pdfs, Satellites view, Shared satellites, Checks
definition: Name of the satellite network (the ITU filing), e.g. STEAM-1. This is the filing's name, not an individual satellite's name, even though the SNL page heads the column 'Satellite Name'.
itu_label_and_code: SNL: 'Satellite Name'; PDF cover: 'Satellite network'; PDF data pages: A1a 'Sat. Network'

sheets: Overview, networks, milestones, pdfs, Satellites view
definition: ITU country symbol of the notifying administration (the national regulator that submitted the filing), e.g. NOR, USA, G. ITU symbols are not ISO codes (D = Germany, G = United Kingdom).
itu_label_and_code: SNL: 'ADM'; PDF cover: 'Responsible Adm.'; A1f1 'Notif. Adm.'

definition: English name of the country for the ADM symbol, from itu_country_codes.csv.
Symbol of the intergovernmental satellite organization that submitted the filing on behalf of its member administrations, if any (e.g. EUTELSAT, INTELSAT). Empty for all current Res 35 networks.
itu_label_and_code: SNL: 'IGSO'; A1f3 'Inter. sat. org.'; SNS field ntwk_org

definition: The later of (a) the end of the 7-year regulatory period for bringing the frequency assignments into use (RR No. 11.44) and (b) 1 January 2021. All milestone periods are counted from this date: M0 at +0, M1 at +2, M2 at +5 and M3 at +7 years.

Status of each Res 35 milestone, cleaned (see status_clean on the milestones sheet). M0 = initial deployment information (resolves 2 and 3); M1, M2, M3 = 1st, 2nd and 3rd milestones (resolves 7a-c and 8a-c), with minimum deployment of 10%, 50% and 100% of the total number of satellites (resolves 11).

Post-milestone deployment reports under resolves 19 of Res 35, due 30 days after the 11-year period following the end of the 7-year period (1 February 2032 for resolves 3 networks), then every 4 years (resolves 20). Empty until the first reports are due.
Total number of space stations (satellites) in the network's latest notification information, i.e. the Res 35 'total number of satellites': the sum of item A.4.b.4.b over the notified orbital planes.
itu_label_and_code: SNL: 'No. of notified space stations'; BR112 'Total number of space stations notified'

definition: Total number of space stations reported as deployed in the network's latest published Res 35 submission.
itu_label_and_code: SNL: 'No. of deployed space stations'; BR113 'Total number of space stations deployed'

definition: total_deployed / total_notified x 100. Calculated by us; the oldest PDFs print the same measure per frequency band.
itu_label_and_code: BR120 'Percentage of space stations deployed vs notified' (oldest PDFs)

definition: TRUE when total_deployed is larger than total_notified (e.g. HIBLEO-2FL: 75 deployed, 66 notified).

Summary of the network's SNL row. Values: '100% deployed at first report' (the first published report already showed full deployment, so earlier milestones are blank, e.g. SLEIPNER-1, USCSID-P); 'At least one milestone met'; 'No milestone met yet' (only 'As Received' or future deadlines so far).
Latest milestone (M0-M3) whose status is Met or Partially Met.
English text of any note the Radiocommunication Bureau printed in the PDF, e.g. the Radio Regulations Board's resolves 12 waiver for 3ECOM-1 and 3ECOM-3.
Link to the network's most recent published Res 35 PDF.
Unknown. Hidden on the SNL page and always equal to the network name so far; possibly for renamed networks.
Unknown. Hidden on the SNL page and always empty so far.

sheets: milestones, pdfs, Satellites view, Checks, bands
definition: Which Res 35 report this is: M0 (initial deployment information), M1, M2 or M3.
Date the milestone period ends (7-year limit + 0/2/5/7 years). The administration's report is due 30 days after this date (resolves 7; for resolves 3 networks the fixed dates in resolves 8).
itu_label_and_code: Groups table BR110 'Expiry of the milestone period'; SNL shows it as a date before a status exists

definition: The milestone cell exactly as shown on the SNL page (a status, a date, or blank).

Cleaned status: Met / Not Met / Partially Met / Not Met, resolves 12 applies / As Received / Pending / Deadline passed, no status shown / Skipped (completed early) / Blank. 'As Received' means submitted to the Bureau and posted as received, but not yet examined and published (resolves 5a, 10a).
Serial number of the BR IFIC (the Bureau's International Frequency Information Circular, published every two weeks) in which the PDF was published.
itu_label_and_code: PDF cover: 'BR IFIC / Date'; bundle field wic_no

definition: Special Section number exactly as printed on the PDF cover. RES35/16 = the 16th Res 35 Special Section; 'MOD-1' = first modified (republished) version. Not a milestone number.
itu_label_and_code: PDF cover: 'Special Section No.' (e.g. RES35/16 MOD-1)

definition: Download link of the PDF on the ITU site.
PDF file name without '.pdf', e.g. RES350016M1 = RES35 + Special Section 0016 + MOD 1.
Special Section number exactly as printed on the PDF cover, e.g. RES35/16 MOD-1.
Publication date of that BR IFIC.
Identification number(s) of this Res 35 submission exactly as printed on page 1, e.g. 121935017 / 123535017. The oldest PDFs print one number.
itu_label_and_code: PDF cover: 'Identification number'; PDF data pages: 'BR6a/BR6b Id. no.'

definition: Date the Radiocommunication Bureau received the Res 35 information.
itu_label_and_code: PDF cover: 'Information received by the Bureau on'; data pages: BR1 'Date of receipt'

definition: Orbital longitude for geostationary filings; 'NGSO' (non-geostationary) for every Res 35 PDF.
Totals printed in this PDF.
itu_label_and_code: BR112 'Total number of space stations notified' / BR113 'Total number of space stations deployed'

definition: Which PDF table layout was read: 'old' or 'new (BR134)' (newer PDFs have the ITU_SAT_ID column).
Processing columns: page count; failed checks; how the PDF was matched to an SNL row; where a PDF contradicts itself (e.g. RES350008M2's data pages say STEAM-2).

Identification number of the notification whose orbital planes and frequency groups are listed. It is very likely the ITU notice ID (ntc_id): the ITU_SAT_ID format is [ntc_id]_[orb_id]_[orb_sat_id] and its first part equals this number.
itu_label_and_code: Tables: 'BR6a/BR6b Id no.' (newer PDFs: 'BR6a Id. no.')

definition: Number of the orbital plane in the notification. Middle part of ITU_SAT_ID (orb_id).
Inclination angle of the orbit with respect to the Earth's equatorial plane, in degrees.
Apogee as an ALTITUDE: the farthest altitude of the satellite above the Earth's surface, in km (not the apogee radius from Earth's centre).
Perigee as an ALTITUDE: the nearest altitude of the satellite above the Earth's surface, in km.
Argument of perigee: angle in degrees between the ascending node and the perigee.
Number of space stations notified in this orbital plane.
itu_label_and_code: A.4.b.4.b 'No. of space stations in this plane' (under 'Orbital parameters in the notification')

definition: Number of space stations reported deployed in this orbital plane.
itu_label_and_code: BR111 'Number of space stations deployed in this plane' (under 'Data from the Res 35 submission')

definition: Number of the launch within this PDF (1, 2, 3 ...). Restarts in every PDF.
Date of the launch.
Company or agency that provided the launch.
itu_label_and_code: BR34 'Name of the launch vehicle provider'

definition: Rocket used, as printed (may be cut short, e.g. 'US GOVERNMENT VEHICL').
Launch site, e.g. CAPE CANAVERAL.
ITU country symbol of the launch facility's location.
English name for launch_country.
Coordinates of the launch facility as printed, in degrees, minutes and seconds (e.g. 080W31 48).
Set when a launch row could not be split cleanly into provider / vehicle / facility.
Number of the frequency band within this PDF.
Lower and upper edge of the frequency band, in MHz.
itu_label_and_code: BR114 'Frequency band': BR115 'Freq min (MHz)', BR116 'Freq max (MHz)' (groups: BR47)

definition: Space stations notified that use this band.
itu_label_and_code: BR118 'Number of space stations notified by frequency band'

definition: Space stations deployed that use this band.
itu_label_and_code: BR119 'Number of space stations deployed by frequency band'

definition: 10% / 50% / 100% of stations_notified for M1 / M2 / M3, rounded down (resolves 11a; resolves 4 allows 100% minus one). Blank in the oldest PDFs.
itu_label_and_code: BR130 'Minimum number of deployed space stations to meet the current Milestone'

definition: The milestone examined and the Bureau's finding for this band (YES/NO).
Percentage printed in the oldest PDFs.
itu_label_and_code: BR120 'Percentage of space stations deployed vs notified' (oldest PDFs only)

definition: 'See Note' as printed; the note's text is in bureau_notes.
itu_label_and_code: Printed next to the finding, e.g. 'M1 / NO (See Note)'

definition: Operator's name for the deployed satellite, e.g. Starlink-1007. Now the first column.
Row number of the satellite within its launch in this PDF (restarts at 1 for each launch). Not a permanent ID.
ITU's unique satellite ID, format [ntc_id]_[orb_id]_[orb_sat_id] = notice ID, orbital plane, satellite number in the plane. Only in newer PDFs.
Frequency bands the satellite uses, comma-separated (see freq_band_id on the bands sheet).

definition: Copied from the pdfs sheet so each satellite row shows when it was published and when the Bureau received it.
Apogee, perigee and inclination of the satellite's orbital plane as given in the notification (planes sheet), placed next to the reported values.
Reported value minus notified value. Positive = higher than notified.
TRUE if the row comes from the network's most recent PDF. Filter to TRUE for one row per satellite per network.
Networks whose latest PDF lists the same satellite name, and how many.
One row per change found between two weekly runs.
'M' marks a group submitted in this Res 35 submission.
Designation (name) of the satellite antenna beam.
E = transmitting (emission) beam, R = receiving beam.
ID of the group of frequency assignments.
Date the group's frequency assignments were brought into use.
Milestone this group is at.
End of the current milestone period.
Y/N: whether this group met the milestone criteria.
